title: Sonarqube: One CBOR-parsing issue in jackson-dataformats-binary's CBOR module: an unbounded run of CBOR tags drives…
description: A security vulnerability in Sonarqube affects versions prior to 26.8.0.126808-r7 and 26.3.0.120487-r10. The issue is in the CBOR module of jackson-dataformats-binary, where an unbounded run of CBOR tags causes quadratic-time growth in the TagList, leading to CPU and garbage collection exhaustion. This results in a denial-of-service (DoS) condition. The vulnerability has a high severity with a CVSS score of 7.5 and has been proven with a proof-of-concept. Fixed versions are available.
